coverageRegions.scope: Inspected starting port, parking and quay observations; false surfaces retained with explicit reasons. Other unobserved background vehicles may remain.

Every one of the107 reviewed bright-hull connected groups is retained as individual observations or explicit exclusions. Boats outside this inspection window, dark undetected hulls and tiny unresolved craft are not an exhaustive port census.
Inspected terminal car parks and six clearly distinguishable small aircraft; four aircraft outside Calvi administrative boundary archived rather than moved.

exit.contract: E selects a clear accessible shore/deck exit within 28 px of the current hull and updates boarding to that exit; native canOccupy and segment checks run before accepting E.

thresholds.cellRule: Every source pixel in the cell must pass; one rejected pixel clears the cell

metadata.bitOrder: row-major, most significant bit first within each byte
metadata.sourcePixels: Day-colour pixels of the archived JPEGs; runtime day/night does not change classification
metadata.limitations: Colour classification for sparse artistic waves. OSM marine geometry must also accept each point. Not coastline measurement, depth, boat recognition, or collision data.
metadata.priority: Detail lod=1 cells override base lod=0 cells wherever detail coverage exists
